data.name: Tank Battle Classic
data.detailed_description:
A single-player tank combat action game featuring military vehicles of World War II.
Fight enemy forces across a variety of battlefields rendered with retro-style visuals, making use of your tank's performance and the surrounding terrain.

Armor and Penetration

This game does not use a hit point system. A single penetrating shot can destroy a tank.
Armor thickness varies by vehicle and by armor section.
Penetration is affected by impact angle and distance, so targeting weak points and using your own armor effectively are key to survival.

Battlefields

The game currently includes suburban, urban, forest, mountain, and open plain maps.
Additional battlefields are planned for future updates.

Missions

Missions include close-range combat in cover-rich environments, long-range interception battles, encounters in dense fog, and escort operations.
Additional missions are planned for future updates.

Included Vehicles

BT-7, T-34/76, T-34/85, KV-1, KV-2, IS-2
Panzer III, StuG III, Panzer IV, Panther G, Jagdpanther, Tiger I, Tiger II, Hetzer, Sd.Kfz.251/22 Pakwagen, Sd.Kfz.251 Half-track
Additional vehicles are planned for future updates.

Game Systems

  • Earn points by completing missions, then purchase tanks to expand your vehicle roster.

  • In most missions, you can change both friendly and enemy vehicles before deployment.
    Combine vehicles to create a variety of battle situations and playstyles.

  • Vehicle performance can be upgraded for each mission.
    Increase movement speed for close-range combat, improve reload speed for interception battles, and adjust other performance parameters to customize the difficulty to your preferred playstyle.
